title: PRD: Behavioral gates & slimline lanes for hosted inference surface + launch checklist
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: This ticket defines the product requirements and launch checklist for introducing 'behavioral gates' and a slimline lane strategy to the hosted inference surface (chat/completions/embeddings/rerank). Goal is to give customers predictable quality/cost tradeoffs while enabling safe rollouts and automated degradations. This PRD captures the scope, acceptance criteria, telemetry, rollout plan, and pre-launch checks.
background: Operators and customers have requested clearer controls for trading latency and cost against deterministic quality. Current single-surface behavior exposes too much variation across prompt shapes and tenants. We will ship a lightweight lane model (Slimline lanes) with behavioral gates that: 1) make lane choice explicit (fast/standard/accurate), 2) attach deterministic acceptance checks and fallback behavior, and 3) include canary and rollback gates for launch.
goals: Expose 3 standard lanes to hosted API with clear SLAs and cost multipliers: fast, standard, accurate
Provide guardrails that automatically divert traffic to fallback variants when lane-specific quality or latency thresholds break
Ensure launch safety with eval-driven canaries using representative prompt sets per customer tier
Make acceptance and failure modes observable in Console with lane-level telemetry and actionable alerts
scope_in: API: Add optional 'lane' parameter to hosted endpoints (chat/completions/embeddings/rerank)
Behavioral gates: per-lane QA thresholds (latency, output-regression score, rerank stability)
Console: Lane-level dashboards and alert rules for P50/P95 latency, per-prompt regression rate, error budget burn
Rollout: Canary harness that runs eval sets against production variant and rollback automation on gate failure
Docs: User guide + migration examples and recommended prompt engineering for each lane
scope_out: New hardware procurement or Dedicated capacity changes (handled by Dedicated team tickets)
Per-tenant custom lane definition for GA (post-GA roadmap item)
Rewriting model selection logic across Dedicated clusters (only routing knobs exposed initially)
acceptance_criteria: API: 'lane' parameter accepted by /v1/completions, /v1/chat, /v1/embeddings, /v1/rerank and defaults to 'standard' when omitted
Latency: For a representative short-prompt suite, fast lane median latency <= 90ms, standard lane median <= 140ms; P95 targets within 2x median for all lanes

Quality: For gen/chat, automated eval set must show no more than 2% drift vs control on ROUGE/BLEU-equivalent metric for 'standard' lane; 'accurate' must improve quality by >=5% vs 'standard' on the curated eval set
Rerank stability: For top-10 rerank outputs, rank-order flip rate <= 1% across identical inputs for the same model variant in 'standard' lane
Embeddings consistency: Cosine similarity variance < 0.005 across repeated calls for identical inputs in 'standard' lane
Fallbacks: On lane gate breach (latency or quality), traffic automatically routes to a preconfigured compatible fallback within 30s and Dashboard shows clear annotation
Telemetry: Console surfaces lane-level P50/P95 latency, per-lane token cost estimates, per-lane regression-rate, and canary status; all metrics retained per contract
Docs: Public docs updated with lane descriptions, pricing multipliers, and migration notes
Security: Security review complete and SSO/KMS impacts documented (security_review_required = true)
launch_checklist: PR: API change merged (GitHub PR #/link in Links) and SDKs updated (Python/Node) with 'lane' param
Evals: Canary evals configured with representative prompt sets for top 20 customers and green for 72h
Dashboard: Lane dashboards and alerting recipes created and smoke-tested
Runbook: Incident and rollback runbook published and reviewed by SRE
Pricing: Pricing multiplier documented and billing hooks validated on staging
Support: Support playbook and canned responses prepared for top 10 customer questions
Docs: User guide + migration examples published and linked in Console
Legal/Compliance: Data residency and audit log changes validated for Private deployments
telemetry_and_alerting: Per-lane metrics: p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, token_cost_estimate, error_rate, regression_rate
Canary alert: regression_rate > 1.5% sustained for 30m triggers PagerDuty play
Latency alert: p95_latency > lane_threshold for 10m triggers Slack ops channel
Fallback audit: every automatic fallback must write audit event with reason and percent traffic affected
risks_mitigation: Risk: Lane choices confuse customers -> Mitigation: Clear docs and console UX that recommend lanes by use-case and sample prompts
Risk: Regression in accuracy on 'standard' lane -> Mitigation: Eval gates + staged canary across customer buckets before launch
Risk: Increased cost for customers accidentally choosing 'accurate' -> Mitigation: Confirm opt-in language in Console and billing preview during lane selection
Risk: Complex interactions with Dedicated autoscaling -> Mitigation: Notify Dedicated team and limit GA to hosted capacity slices
